newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Selva Capital Corp issues 2 yr $5 mln euro note.
newsitem.headline: Selva Capital Corp issues 2 yr $5 mln euro note.

text.p: British Virgin Islands listed Selva Capital Corporation is to issue a two year $5 million eurobond on September 20 with an 11 percent coupon, sole manager Venezuela-based Andino Capital Markets said.
The bond, priced at 476 basis points over comparable U.S. treasuries, is the first to be sold under Selva's $20 million borrowing program, Andino said in a press release.
The series is guaranteed by Inversiones Selva C.A., a Venezuelan plastics distributor.
